mentions.name: leafle
mentions.description: A book-discovery app that recommends new books based on a deeper understanding of what the reader likes than typical 'people who read X also read Y' suggestions, and surfaces titles that can be borrowed right away from local libraries. It works with about 6,500 public libraries around the world and uses LLMs to reverse-engineer the reader's tastes.
mentions.problem: Typical book recommendations ('people who read X also read Y') are too shallow and don't account for what the reader actually likes or what is immediately borrowable at their local library.
mentions.audience: Mostly for personal use by the author
mentions.source_excerpt: working on http://leafle.org my app (mostly for me) to find new books to read that I wouldn't have thought of (mostly recently Cosmicomics) based on a deeper understanding of what I like in books than people who read X also read Y, that I can actually borrow right away from my local library. Works on ~6,500 public libraries around the world.
mentions.author: kidnoodle
